_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 128 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: Handheld Jammer

description.text: A portable electronic warfare device that, when active, temporarily disrupts the function of enemy equipment within its range. The device is audible when in use, and can be carried by the user or tossed as a diversion.
